title: Hands-on: Mophie’s new battery banks offer pocketable power, built-in cables at low price - 9to5Mac
summary: Mophie’s new PowerStation Plus battery banks come in Standard and Signature variants, each with 5000mAh and 10000mAh capacity options. The lower three variants of the PowerStation Plus come with one built-in cable, whereas the Signature 10K version has two braided cables.
